invitation.note: Bytes, compressed, of everything /{language}/i loads before interaction, for its largest language. Set in October 2026 at 97,663 gzip and 85,243 brotli (Spanish) plus about 10%; raised for the Tandem design (its stylesheet, the mark, the appearance switch) at 109,319 gzip and 95,327 brotli (Spanish) plus about 10%. `fonts` is the bytes, as stored, of the two fonts the page preloads (Instrument Sans 400 and Gabarito 900, subset), set at 33,072 plus about 10%; the other fonts load when used (font-display: swap) and are not counted. How and when to raise it: scripts/check-budget.mjs.
